recommendations: Preserve the already agreed MDB Effect Category contract for MXF as a fresh small adapter around the current standalone catalogue.
Use only final selected Precompute Type/name and same qualified master; do not traverse other packages to find a prettier recognized effect.
Call once for selected master/name during processing, reuse Effect and Category for associated physical rows, derive again if selected inputs change.
Retain every distinct matching category in catalogue order joined with /, rather than picking a category arbitrarily.
Unknown remains a selectable exact label for Precompute categories; ordinary/unknown Type blank.
Keep existing suffix/case/localized compatibility behavior and useful tests; do not create a second decoder, permanent cache or big category-enum framework.
Do not keep a separately derived Effect Sequence. Legacy helper computes one for OldScanner, but it is not a Bella retained requirement.
No new media-header opening reason or broad priority decision is introduced.
currentRouteAndCapturedNames.observerMethod: Independent Python source-derived token/catalogue observer; not production C++/Qt execution. Observed input retained no parsed Sequence value.

proposedBellaRules.inputs: Already qualified MXF MaterialPackage Name and independently established Type; final selected Clip Name and Type after matching/source selection.
proposedBellaRules.encoding: MXF Name decoded as supported UTF-16BE. Output category comes from existing compiled catalogue, not a separate header category scalar or new legacy-text fallback.
proposedBellaRules.lookup: For a confirmed Precompute, reuse existing AvidEffects::lookup once for selected master/name during processing. Reuse Effect and Effect Category for associated rows; recompute after selected inputs change.
proposedBellaRules.behaviour: Keep exact case, validated numeric suffix forms, aliases/localized names, explicit 3DWarp alias and every distinct ambiguous category in catalogue order joined with /.
proposedBellaRules.retention: Owned QString Effect/Effect Category results with necessary compact derived context. Temporary same-master/name reuse; no permanent name cache or source-history framework.
proposedBellaRules.unavailable: Precompute unavailable/unrecognised category displays lowercase unknown. Media/unknown Type category blank. Does not modify independently proven Type or Precompute Category.
proposedBellaRules.exclusions: No additional media read, effect graph, plug-in/resource load or import-settings body solely for this label. No Effect Sequence retained in Bella rows/results/filters/CSV.
proposedBellaRules.identityLimit: Name-derived recognition does not prove the original generating effect ID or active plug-in. Native effect registration is a different input path.
proposedBellaRules.scope: No new cross-source priority/opening policy or measured performance improvement. Preserve the agreed catalogue through a small new adapter.
